rules: Headings must use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight).
Overlines/Labels must be uppercase, tiny, and wide spacing (tracking-[0.2em]).
Use JetBrains Mono or IBM Plex Mono for all YAML ADL codes, Event Bus Logs, and raw metrics.
Do NOT use Space Grotesk or Inter for headings.
Avoid true black (#000000). Use Dark Void (hsl(240,10%,4%)) for elevation and depth.
Use highly desaturated dark grays for surfaces, with 1px high-contrast borders.
Primary color (Cyan) should be used sparingly for true calls to action or active states.
Color is function only. Most UI should be monochrome dark.

surfaces: Use 'Grid Borders (The Technical Look)' for the developer console.
Cards should have a flat background, 1px subtle border, NO soft shadows. Use sharp or very slightly rounded edges (rounded-sm).
Expose the grid: Use visible 1px borders between bento box elements to feel like a blueprint.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Avoid muddy transparency. Use solid backgrounds or high-end blur (backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60) with 1px border-white/10 for sticky headers.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay on the main background to kill digital flatness and enhance the 'OS layer' luxury feel.

shadcn: Use Shadcn primitives but heavily customize their classes. Ensure .js / .jsx usage.
Tables: High density. Use Mono font for IDs, Statuses, and Dates.
Tabs: Use crisp, under-lined technical tabs, not rounded pills.
Code Editor: Integrate a real syntax highlighter or use a styled textarea with JetBrains Mono for the ADL YAML with real-time validation visual cues.
Cards: Strip away default rounding (use rounded-sm at most).
Toasts: Use Sonner for notifications (e.g., 'Agent Compiled', 'Event Bus Error').
components.icons: Use Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) for a technical, crisp look.

grids_and_layouts.strategy: High Density Grid (For Dashboards / OS Panels)
rules: Base Grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-12.
Gap Strategy: Tight (gap-4 or gap-[1px] with bg-border to create 1px grid lines).
F-Pattern Hierarchy: Critical ecosystem numbers top-left. Event bus stream right/bottom.
Spacing: Dense and compact to fit data without scrolling. p-4 or p-6 inside cards.
Optical Alignment: Maintain strict vertical rhythms for lists and event logs.
Minimalist and user-controlled. No inescapable animations.
Use micro-interactions for feedback (hover states: -translate-y-[1px], border color shift to Cyan).
Staggered entrance for agent lists/tables.
Compile/Validation workflows in the ADL editor should have a distinct 'scanning' or 'processing' animation.
Normal text minimum 4.5:1 contrast against dark background.
Interactive states must explicitly set text color (e.g., hover:bg-secondary hover:text-white).
Data-testid attributes MUST be added to all interactive elements, e.g., data-testid='compile-adl-btn'.

3d_libraries.recommendation: Recharts for Monitoring KPIs (CPU/Memory of agents). D3.js ONLY if building an interactive node-graph of the Agent Ecosystem. Otherwise, stick to standard dense 2D visualizations via Recharts.

abstract_tech_bg.description: Dynamic abstract neon lights, useful for a subtle hero background on the login page or OS boot screen (heavily overlaid with bg-black/80).

agent_000_avatar.description: White robot face on black background, perfect for Agent 000's profile picture or default agent avatars.

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building an 'Agent Operating System Layer'. It must feel like a high-end developer console, not a generic SaaS dashboard.
Use a dark theme by default, adjusting the CSS variables in index.css to match the Deep Void / Cyan accent scheme.
Ensure all `.js` and `.jsx` files adhere to the strict typographical hierarchy. Use Cabinet Grotesk for section titles, JetBrains Mono for agent IDs/code.
For the ADL Editor, ensure the YAML input uses a monospace font and has a visual 'Compile' workflow.
Never use `transparent` backgrounds for headers or dropdowns. Always use solid `bg-card` or `bg-background` to prevent text collision.
Include `data-testid` on all buttons, links, and forms.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid generic, 'on distribution' AI outputs. Do not make generic centered layouts.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) where floating elements are needed.
NEVER apply universal transitions (`transition: all`). Target specific properties.
NEVER center align the app container in App.css.
Use modern button styles (sharp technical corners or slight rounding, not generic pills) with interaction animations.
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover states, transitions).
NEVER use AI assistant emojis (🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯). Use Phosphor icons instead.
